## SECTION 6.5 — MATHEMATICAL KELLY SIZING

- **p (Base+Bull) = 0.75; q (Bear) = 0.25.**
- **Payoff ratio b = (Bull − T0)/(T0 − Bear) = ($29.00 − $12.72)/($12.72 − $9.50) = $16.28 / $3.22 = 5.06.**
- **Full Kelly f\* = (p·b − q)/b = (0.75×5.06 − 0.25)/5.06 = (3.795 − 0.25)/5.06 = 0.7006 ≈ 70.1%.**
- **Quarter-Kelly f\*/4 = 17.5%.**
- **Reconcile to conviction cap:** High-conviction band is 5–8%. Quarter-Kelly (17.5%) **exceeds** the cap → **capped recommended ledger weight = 6.0%.**

> The raw quarter-Kelly is large because the downside is cushioned by the net-cash floor (small denominator in *b*). The conviction cap, not the Kelly math, is the binding constraint — appropriate for a binary special situation with FX-tainted cash.

## SECTION 7 — RISKS & INSTITUTIONAL PRE-MORTEM

**Core risks:** (1) **Deal risk** — DUG's $11.25 lowball is accepted, capping the minority at ~$11.25 (still above the cash floor, but below Base). (3) **FX reversal** — part of the $521M cash is unrealized FX; an adverse KRW/USD/EUR move shrinks the floor. (4) **UK gambling tax** — permanent iGaming margin headwind. (5) **Category decline** — >5% global social-casino contraction in 2026 per management. (6) **ADR liquidity / basis** — thin float, Korean reporting, potential delisting/ADR friction.

**5-Year Failure Pre-Mortem ("Assume we lost 50% of capital in 5 years — what went wrong?"):** The deal failed and DUG, now the unchallenged controller, extracted the $521M cash via related-party distributions and a string of low-ROI M&A; the DTC margin advantage was eroded by peer copycat and the UK/EU tax regime, cutting FCF from ~$140M to ~$60M; an adverse FX swing removed another ~$70M of paper cash; the ADR was delisted or illiquid, trapping the position at ~$6–7/ADS. **Tail risk:** Moderate. The true tail is **controller expropriation of the net cash**, not a business failure (the business is debt-free and cash-generative). Probability low, impact high — hence the 6% cap and the invalidation trigger on net-cash level.

**5-Bullet Institutional Short Thesis:**

2. **The cash is the controller's to take.** At 67.1%, DUG can distribute, related-party, or M&A the $521M away from the minority — the "cash floor" is illusory.
3. **The FCF is FX and timing, not quality.** $146M/yr "realized FCF" is inflated by unrealized FX gains and a one-time working-capital release; normalize it and the operating business is worth ~$0.
4. **The category is dying.** >5% social-casino decline in 2026, UK tax on iGaming — the DTC shift is a margin band-aid on a shrinking top line.
5. **ADR / EM trap.** Thin float, Korean reporting, delisting risk — you can't exit a "value" thesis in a 60K-share/day tape.

**Long vs. Short Combat Scoring:**

- Short bullet 5: **Valid for sizing** — this is exactly why the position is capped at 6%, not 17.5%.
